checks.explanation: Lutnick predicted cutting $1 trillion in waste/fraud/abuse and raising $1 trillion in new tariff revenue to balance the budget. In practice, DOGE's cost-cutting goal was repeatedly scaled back -- by an April 2026 Cabinet meeting Musk cited only about $150 billion in FY2026 savings, a small fraction of the original $1 trillion target, and the federal budget remains far from balanced.

sources.title: Elon Musk touts $150B in savings in FY2026 -- after claiming DOGE could cut $1T - AOL

checks.explanation: Lutnick said the Trump Card/Gold Card program would 'go out' about two weeks from the interview (~late March 2025). In reality, the executive order creating the Gold Card wasn't signed until September 19, 2025, and the public application process didn't open until December 10, 2025 -- roughly 8-9 months later, not two weeks.

sources.title: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Launches the Gold Card Program - The White House
'Trump Gold Card' launches, offering expedited residency - CNN

checks.explanation: Lutnick cited the president's estimate of selling around 1 million Gold Cards (~$5 trillion). In practice, uptake has been far lower: by May 2026 the program had received only 338 applications, with 165 paid fee-payers and just one formal approval -- nowhere close to a million.

sources.title: Trump Gold Card 2026: Only One Approval Amid Tax Hurdles - VisaVerge

checks.explanation: Lutnick predicted the administration would issue a rule mandating post-quantum cryptography protections. On June 22, 2026, Trump signed an executive order ('Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks') directing an accelerated federal migration to post-quantum cryptography, with 2030/2031 deadlines -- occurring during this administration as predicted.

sources.title: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Secures the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks - The White House

checks.explanation: Lutnick predicted a taxi-medallion-style financing industry would build up around Gold/Trump Cards. Dedicated financing services (e.g., goldcardvisafinance.com) offering loans against collateral for the $1M Gold Card fee have since emerged, matching the prediction.

Lutnick predicted Trump would force through the Constitution Pipeline, halving East Coast gas prices. Despite Trump's public backing, the pipeline was not approved -- on November 7, 2025, the Constitution Pipeline Company withdrew its water-quality certification application in New York. A different project (the Northeast Supply Enhancement pipeline) was approved instead.

sources.title: New York Approves Trump-Backed Gas Pipeline - NY Focus
